Package com.agrialert.data_manager

Class GroupWithFields

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.data_manager.GroupWithFields
public class GroupWithFields extends Object
Represents a relationship between a group and its associated fields.

This class is used to perform a join-like operation, retrieving a FieldsGroup along with all its related Field entities.
